usage: Cloud-density texture in the real-time sky shader. Sun, moon, stars and lighting are separate runtime objects; this is not a rendered-world screenshot.
brief: A starless blue sky with sweeping cirrus and silver-cream cloud edges, broad clear areas, a 2:1 panoramic composition, no terrain, architecture, people, sun or moon. Mature fantasy atmosphere with a bright readable horizon.
processing: PNG to WebP, quality 94; no content edits.
